positions.name: AnalyticsDatabaseDecision
positions.frame: What database technology is being adopted for the analytics pipeline, on what performance basis, and on what migration timeline?
positions.why: All six expressions cohere as a single decision package: the technology choice (Zypherion for analytics), its performance justification (15x faster columnar queries), and the migration timeline (Q3 2026). Each fact appears in both a prose statement and its memo-bullet restatement, the latter carrying memo-author footing that formalizes the decision. The directional read spans the full scope of the decision — what, why, and when — without collapsing into a synthesis.
